title: supply-chain: Makefile ships `publish:` and `publish-test:` targets that run `python3 -m twine upload dist/*` to P…
description:
[P2 · supply-chain · audit] Makefile ships `publish:` and `publish-test:` targets that run `python3 -m twine upload dist/*` to PyPI/TestPyPI, contradicting the repo's stated GitHub-only distribution policy. Not auto-run, but a footgun that could publish this private community tool to public PyPI.

Evidence: Makefile:6-10 `publish: build` / `python3 -m twine upload dist/*` and `publish-test:` → testpypi

Fix: Remove the publish/publish-test twine targets (or replace with a `gh release` flow). pyproject has no publishConfig, so no other PyPI exposure — just the Makefile.

Source: launch-readiness audit 2026-06-18
